evals.name: default-brandbook-from-outline
evals.prompt: Build me a 6-slide deck introducing our team's new code-review automation policy to engineering. Slides: (1) title, (2) why the policy exists — three reasons, (3) what changes in PR flow, (4) tooling we'll roll out — three tools in a card row, (5) what we're measuring — three KPI callouts, (6) timeline and Q&A. Save it to ./code-review-policy.pptx. Don't ask me which brandbook — pick a sensible default.
evals.expected_output: 6-slide pptx at ./code-review-policy.pptx with default (AAB) brandbook, every slide has a visual element, varied layouts, no placeholder text.

assertions.text: code-review-policy.pptx exists and is a valid pptx
Deck contains exactly 6 slides
Slide text covers all 6 outline sections (policy/reasons, PR flow, tooling, KPIs/metrics, timeline)
Every slide has at least one non-text element (shape, image, or chart)
Layouts are varied — at least 3 distinct slide layouts used across the deck
No leftover placeholder text (lorem, xxxx, TODO)
A brandbook was chosen and applied (consistent palette across slides)

evals.name: named-brandbook-anthropic
evals.prompt: Use the Anthropic brandbook to create an 8-slide pitch deck for a hypothetical research product called 'Hindsight' — an AI-powered post-mortem tool for engineering teams. Outline: title, problem (no visibility into past incidents), solution overview, three product capabilities (in a card row), demo screenshot placeholder, customer logos placeholder, pricing tiers (table), closing CTA. Output to ./hindsight-pitch.pptx. After building, render preview images and tell me what issues you spotted.
evals.expected_output: 8-slide pptx at ./hindsight-pitch.pptx using Anthropic palette (cream bg, clay accent), pricing table, preview images rendered, notes.md with spotted issues.

assertions.text: hindsight-pitch.pptx exists and is a valid pptx
Deck contains exactly 8 slides
Anthropic cream background (#FAF9F5) appears on majority of slides
Anthropic clay accent (#D97757) appears at least once
At least one slide contains a pptx table (pricing tiers)
Visual review performed: preview PNGs exist OR notes.md describes inspection
notes.md exists and lists at least 2 specific issues
Title slide mentions 'Hindsight' product name
No leftover placeholder text

evals.name: sample-deck-style-mimicry
evals.prompt: Here's a sample deck from a colleague: /Users/andisblukis/Documents/CCW/module-2.6-eval-driven-dev.pptx. Build me a new 5-slide deck on 'Observability for Agent Systems' that matches this sample's visual style (palette, typography, layout patterns), but with completely different content. Save to ./observability-deck.pptx.
evals.expected_output: 5-slide pptx at ./observability-deck.pptx on observability topic with no copied content, style echoing the sample's navy+teal palette and 3-column card layouts.

assertions.text: observability-deck.pptx exists and is a valid pptx
Deck contains exactly 5 slides
Slide text covers observability topic (mentions observability/agents/monitoring/traces)
Slide text does NOT duplicate sample content (no 'pass@k', 'eval-first', 'grader', 'swiss cheese')
Style observations recorded in notes.md
Style matches sample (navy/teal palette OR otherwise mirrors sample colors)
At least one slide uses card-row layout echoing sample
No leftover placeholder text
